Title: 2.x: Observable.switchMapCompletable does not call action on completion
Description: Maybe I’m using it wrong though. I’ve prepared some tests.

```kotlin
import io.reactivex.Completable
import io.reactivex.functions.Action
import io.reactivex.schedulers.TestScheduler
import io.reactivex.subjects.PublishSubject
import org.junit.Test
import org.mockito.Mockito
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class CompletableTest {

    private class Environment {

        private val completableSeconds = 5

        val timeScheduler = TestScheduler()
        val action = Mockito.mock(Action::class.java)

        val observable = PublishSubject.create<Unit>()
        val completable = Completable.timer(completableSeconds.toLong(), TimeUnit.SECONDS, timeScheduler)

        fun trigger() {
            observable.onNext(Unit)
            timeScheduler.advanceTimeBy(completableSeconds.toLong(), TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        }
    }

    @Test fun pass_directSubscription() {
        val env = Environment()

        env.observable.subscribe { env.completable.subscribe(env.action) }

        env.trigger()

        Mockito.verify(env.action).run()
    }

    @Test fun fail_switchMapCompletable() {
        val env = Environment()

        env.observable.switchMapCompletable { env.completable }.subscribe(env.action)

        env.trigger()

        Mockito.verify(env.action).run()
    }
}
```
